notes.authority_boundary: PR35 and PR36 remain research-only and frozen. This separate actuator may materialize only a candidate that has already passed both formal prospective gates.
notes.scope: Only the explicitly allowlisted GPW/US Daily score threshold may be changed autonomously. Hard safety gates, code, sizing and arbitrary config keys are outside authority.
notes.rollback: The promoted policy is monitored on subsequent resolved production outcomes. Existing conservative rollback thresholds restore the immutable parent policy automatically and block the failed transition.
notes.durability: Production state is committed atomically with allowlisted config changes so the next run can reconcile research state even if a private Actions artifact is lost.
